short: Turkey has no AI act. Two AI bills are before the Grand National Assembly: Bill 2/2234, the Yapay Zeka Kanun Teklifi, referred on 25 June 2024, and Bill 2/3358 on AI generated hate speech and deepfakes, referred on 10 November 2025.
title: Turkey AI Laws
subtitle: No AI act; two AI bills referred to committee in the Grand National Assembly
body_html:
Status at a glance

No AI act; bills in committee. Two AI bills have been referred to committee in the Grand National Assembly. Their status after referral has not been verified. Verified on 13 November 2026 against the Assembly's own document server.

Key instruments

BillSubjectFiled byReferred
2/2234Yapay Zeka Kanun Teklifi (Artificial Intelligence Bill)Ömer Faruk Gergerlioğlu (DEM Party, Kocaeli)25 June 2024, to the Industry, Trade, Energy, Natural Resources, Information and Technology Committee as lead and the Justice Committee as secondary
2/3358Amends the Turkish Penal Code No. 5237 and other laws to address AI generated hate speech and deepfakesHalil Öztürk (MHP, Kırıkkale)10 November 2025, to the same lead committee, with the Justice and Digital Media committees as secondary

Who regulates and enforces

No AI regulator exists while no AI act is in force. The bills sit with the Industry, Trade, Energy, Natural Resources, Information and Technology Committee.

What is coming next

  • Committee action on Bills 2/2234 and 2/3358.

Related

  • Global AI Laws: every jurisdiction compared, with the world map
  • AI Policy Ledger, the law tracker

Sources

  • Bill 2/2234, Yapay Zeka Kanun Teklifi, Grand National Assembly of Türkiye
  • Bill 2/3358, amending the Turkish Penal Code No. 5237, Grand National Assembly of Türkiye (scanned)

Last verified

13 November 2026, against the Assembly's document server. Bill 2/3358 is a scanned file; its cover and general rationale were read. The bills' status after referral is not verified.
